claim: Works offline after the first visit
where: landing facts, app offline notice, README
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo/; activate the service worker, go offline, reload, and assert the populated demo remains usable

claim: Voice recordings stay in this browser
where: landing facts, recording form, privacy page, README
sandbox: record through the demo UI; assert an audio Blob exists in demo:vocab-confusion-log and every request is same-origin

claim: Ordinary logging and practice send no personal data
where: landing privacy section, privacy page, README
sandbox: capture every request while completing a demo practice and assert all requests stay on the product origin

claim: No analytics or tracking runs in the product
sandbox: use the demo, capture requests and sendBeacon calls, and assert no cookies, beacons, or third-party requests

claim: Practice switches between audio-to-text and text-to-audio when both recordings exist
sandbox: complete the seeded audio-to-text sample, make it due, and assert the next prompt is text-to-audio

claim: A pair resolves after three scheduled correct attempts
where: landing preview and how-it-works section, app, terms, README
sandbox: complete the sample at each due boundary; assert one-day, three-day, and resolved outcomes

claim: JSON backup and restore include pairs, attempt history, and recordings
sandbox: download the demo backup, inspect all sample records and encoded audio, delete a pair, import, and assert it returns

claim: CSV export contains one row for each resolved pair
sandbox: download the demo CSV and assert its header and single resolved sample row

claim: The installable app detects and applies a newer version
sandbox: check the manifest, install the production service worker, change its bytes, request an update, and activate it from the in-app notice

claim: The free plan allows eight active pairs; resolved pairs do not count
where: landing facts and pricing, Data page, terms, README
sandbox: place eight active plus one resolved pair in the demo and assert the next add action is blocked with the limit explanation

claim: Pro costs US$9 once and a valid license removes the active-pair limit
where: landing facts and pricing, Data page, terms, README
sandbox: use a recorded valid verification response in the demo namespace, assert the price and active status, then open the add form above eight active pairs
